name: Lightning Storm
text:
Aspect air

Activate 2 command

---

Effect The relic surrounds you with a storm of wind, rain, and lightning in a 30-foot emanation. This storm is difficult terrain for creatures other than you. Any creature other than you that enters or starts its turn in the storm takes 1d12 electricity damage, with a basic Reflex save save (2d12 electricity damage at 15th level). You can Sustain the activation up to 1 minute.
